description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and accuracy@1 for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The first line, representing GPT-4o, is blue with circular markers and is solid. It begins at a value of 24.4 at x=1, increases to 34.4 at x=5, and then decreases to 31.1 at x=7. The second line, representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet, is light blue with cross markers and is solid. It begins at a value of 26.7 at x=1, increases to 27.8 at x=3, and then decreases to 20.0 at x=7.
